hero.desc.0: Join our team of engineers, designers, sales professionals, and project experts delivering industrial plants across India.
sec.desc.0: We are hiring across Engineering, Instrumentation, Commercial, Procurement, Sales, IT, and Project Management to support turnkey industrial plant projects.
sec.desc.1: Fill in the form below and upload your resume. Our HR team will get back to shortlisted candidates within 7 - 10 working days.
p.0: Join our team of engineers, designers, sales professionals, and project experts delivering industrial plants across India.
p.1: Qualification: B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical / Chemical / Instrumentation Engineering
p.2: Lead on-site commissioning and startup of process plant equipment including evaporators, dryers, dairy processing lines, heat exchangers, and CIP systems at client facilities across India.
p.3: Qualification: B.Tech in Mechanical / Chemical Engineering; PMP / Prince2 preferred
p.4: Manage end-to-end delivery of process plant projects from order receipt to commissioning - overseeing engineering, procurement, fabrication, site execution, and client handover within schedule and budget.
p.5: Qualification: Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or ITI Draftsman
p.6: Prepare detailed engineering drawings for process equipment, piping layouts, and fabrication packages for dairy, chemical, and industrial plant projects.
p.7: Qualification: B.Tech in Chemical / Mechanical Engineering
p.8: Design and optimize process systems for evaporators, dryers, heat exchangers, and turnkey plant solutions based on client requirements and industry standards.
p.9: Qualification: B.Tech in Mechanical / Chemical Engineering
p.10: Prepare accurate cost estimates, BOQs, and technical proposals for industrial equipment supply and turnkey EPC projects.
p.11: Qualification: B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering
p.12: Lead on-site erection, installation, and commissioning of process plants and industrial equipment at client locations across India.
p.13: Qualification: B.Tech in Instrumentation / Electrical Engineering
p.14: Design and implement instrumentation and control systems for process plants including sensors, PLC/SCADA, and automation packages.
p.15: Qualification: MBA / M.Com / BBA in Commerce or Business Administration
p.16: Handle commercial operations including contract review, billing, client coordination, and project commercial documentation for EPC and equipment supply projects.
p.17: Qualification: B.Tech / B.Com / MBA in Supply Chain or related field
p.18: Manage procurement of raw materials, equipment, and vendor supplies for fabrication and turnkey project execution.
p.19: Qualification: B.Tech / B.Sc in Computer Science, Statistics, or Mathematics
p.20: Analyze business and project data to generate insights, reports, and dashboards supporting sales, operations, and management decisions.
p.21: Qualification: B.Tech / MCA / B.Sc in Computer Science or IT
p.22: Develop and maintain company websites, web applications, and AI-integrated tools for sales, marketing, and internal process automation.
p.23: Qualification: MBA / BBA / B.Tech / Any Graduate with sales experience
p.24: Drive business development and client acquisition for industrial equipment, process plants, and engineering solutions across target industries.
p.25: Send your resume with your area of expertise. We review all applications and contact suitable candidates.
p.26: Fill in the form below and upload your resume. Our HR team will get back to shortlisted candidates within 7 - 10 working days.
